automatic_switchblade: Legal to own — ban repealed 11 Oct 2017 (PA 96 of 2017)
concealed_carry: FELONY for dagger/dirk/stiletto/double-edged non-folding — up to 5 yrs / $2500 (MCL 750.227(1))
vehicle_possession: Same felony applies in any vehicle occupied — reachable or not
preemption: NO — MCL 123.1102 covers firearms only; preemption bill vetoed 2021
named_city_ordinances: Detroit and Lansing restrict blades over 3 inches in public places
local_myth: That the 2017 switchblade repeal legalised concealed carry of everything. It did not — MI restricts by blade shape/function, not opening mechanism. Also: the '3-inch rule' in MCL 750.226 only applies once unlawful intent is proven; there is no general 3-inch limit.
